label: Spatial audio
intent: Sound moves around the listener. Light: the sound sweeps from the left, over the top, to the right: each arc in turn pushes in toward the listener and springs back. Strong: the whole sound field winds back, then travels a full turn around the listener, overshoots and settles where it started.

field.rotate.//: a whole turn; once it has stopped, the angle steps from 360 back to 0 (the same picture) so the rest frame is exactly the first
